hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to physically slow vehicle traffic on this residential street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks at intersections or key mid-block locations to provide pedestrians with a designated crossing area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Marking
interventions.description: Use consistent sidewalk materials or high-visibility markings across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority to drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past parked cars.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve visibility and shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming (Speed Humps)
interventions.description: Install speed humps to ensure low vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening or Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles or widen the sidewalk to ensure a consistent, ADA-compliant clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly inspect the sidewalk for potential upheaval caused by the roots of the large mature trees to prevent tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Install speed humps or chicanes to physically slow traffic and reinforce the residential nature of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Installing lighting specifically for the sidewalk would improve safety and comfort during nighttime.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway curb cut to the minimum necessary for vehicle access to shorten the pedestrian exposure distance.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Paint a center line and edge lines to narrow the perceived travel lane and organize traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Repair or replace uneven concrete slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Install street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation or Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the driveway apron to reduce the speed of turning vehicles and minimize the conflict zone for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Pave the missing segments of the sidewalk on the right side to ensure a continuous and accessible walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer / Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a vegetated buffer between the curb and the sidewalk to separate pedestrians from traffic and provide a designated space for utility poles.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement or enforce regulations against parking vehicles (including motorcycles) on the sidewalk to maintain a clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim low-hanging or protruding branches from private property that may obstruct sightlines or the walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and naturally slow traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or humps to physically manage vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or grass verge between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.
